cells.gaps: No station outside the pilot is shown recording digitally: the crime management system was being tested at Warren Park in June 2025 (ZWE-019) and at Warren Park, in Harare, and a couple of other stations in October 2026 (ZWE-001). The electronic docket system was announced in December 2025 as coming soon (ZWE-009). How records are made was last stated in 2024, as uncomputerised (ZWE-021, ZWE-022). No finance is stated inside the 36 months; ZWE-006 to ZWE-008 are from the excluded source.
cells.note: The crime management system is in pilot at Warren Park and a couple of other stations, as the Home Affairs minister said in June 2025 and October 2026. Rung 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in stations outside the capital.
